description: This file is a makefile fragment used for defining version-related variables and dependencies in an OpenWrt/LEDE project. It sets version numbers, URLs, and configuration dependencies, and constructs a sed script for version string substitution.

methods.name: call qstrip
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from input.

methods.name: call sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by converting to lowercase and replacing underscores with hyphens.

methods.name: call taint2sym
methods.description: Converts a taint string to its symbolic configuration name.

methods.name: call taint2name
methods.description: Extracts the name part from a taint string.

methods.name: call sed_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters for sed substitution.
